import json,os
base='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-ceiling/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u073/system/state/workspace/programs'
prog='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rest=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    marker=max(rest,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    pat_cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j] not in (bg,marker)]
    r0,c0=pat_cells[0]
    vert=all(j==c0 for i,j in pat_cells)
    horiz=all(i==r0 for i,j in pat_cells)
    if vert: pat=[grid[i][c0] for i,_ in pat_cells]
    else: pat=[grid[r0][j] for _,j in pat_cells]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    k=len(pat)//2
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if grid[i][j]==marker:
                for idx,v in enumerate(pat):
                    if vert:
                        r=i-k+idx
                        if 0<=r<H: out[r][j]=v
                    elif horiz:
                        c=j-k+idx
                        if 0<=c<W: out[i][c]=v
    return out
'''
